notes:
New Features:

- Dorcel TV now uses Kodi InputStream Adaptive for its direct child HLS stream, including manifest/segment headers. Every other Adult-TV-Channels.com sender keeps the existing native HLS path.

Improvements:

- Dorcel EOF recovery keeps the same isolated InputStream Adaptive route instead of falling back to the native demuxer after a restart.
- Generated playlist labels now use the cleaner format: colored channel name, optional resolution, then the violet Cumination Add-on suffix without an extra outer bracket pair.

Bugfixes:

- Playlist/PVR matching and the three-failed-check parser accept both the old bracketed label format and the new v1.126 format, so existing playlists remain compatible during migration.
